reason: Add a reachable incentive for unused action 3 (right orientation engine) by rewarding horizontal velocity correction toward the pad. Reduce distance penalty magnitude from -1.0 to -0.5 per unit to reduce dense penalty dominance and make progress-delta feedback more effective.
preserved_design: Objective signal (100.0 for successful landing) unchanged.
Vertical speed penalty (-0.3 per unit) unchanged.
Main engine fuel penalty (-0.03 per unit) unchanged.
Orientation engine fuel penalty (-0.01 per unit) unchanged.
changed_design: Distance penalty reduced from -1.0 to -0.5 per unit to reduce dense penalty dominance.
Added new term: horizontal_correction_bonus = +0.5 * (1 if action == 3 and vx * x > 0 else 0) to reward using right orientation engine when horizontal velocity is away from pad.
required_edits_implemented: Preserve behavior that improved the primary metric.
Make one targeted reward edit with an explicit expected metric change.
rejected_patterns_avoided: No repeatable positive rewards without progress: the horizontal_correction_bonus is event-gated (only when vx * x > 0) and not repeatable without progress.
No dense penalty dominance: distance penalty reduced to -0.5.
action_coverage_plan: Add a bonus for using action 3 when horizontal velocity is away from the pad (vx * x > 0). This creates a reachable incentive to use the right orientation engine for horizontal alignment. The bonus is small (0.5) to avoid no-action collapse and is only active when correction is needed.
phase_guidance_plan: The horizontal_correction_bonus guides Phase 1 (descent and horizontal alignment) by rewarding the use of the right engine to center over the pad. The distance penalty (reduced) still provides general progress feedback.
payment_mode_plan: The horizontal_correction_bonus is event-gated (one-shot per step when condition holds) and not repeatable without progress. The objective bonus remains terminal-aligned (one-shot on success).
validation_metrics: Compare generated_reward and fitness_score after training.
Check dominant reward components for single-component dominance.
